title: Content Writer
description:
Job Title: Content Writer

**Company:** Wellcaza School of Health Sciences (under Wellcaza Hospital Pvt Limited)  
**Location:** Elamakkara, Kochi, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Salary:** ₹12,000–₹20,000 per month

Job Description

Wellcaza School of Health Sciences is looking for a creative, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented **Content Writer**  to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a passion for writing, storytelling, and digital marketing, with the ability to create engaging content for social media, websites, blogs, and marketing campaigns.

Freshers with strong writing skills and a creative mindset are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

* Create engaging and persuasive content for social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
* Write creative captions, short-form content, and scripts for Instagram Reels and promotional videos.
* Develop blogs, website content, SEO-friendly articles, and educational content.
* Create compelling marketing copy for advertisements, brochures, posters, and promotional campaigns.
* Draft email campaigns, WhatsApp messages, admission promotions, and student engagement content.
* Adapt content for different audiences, platforms, and communication objectives.
* Support branding, digital marketing, student recruitment, and institutional promotional activities.
* Proofread and edit content to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and grammatical correctness.

Required Skills

* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Creativity in storytelling, copywriting, and promotional content.
* Basic understanding of SEO, keywords, and digital content optimisation.
* Ability to write engaging social media captions and reel scripts.
* Preferred Languages: English, Malayalam, Tamil, and Hindi. Additional Advantage: Telugu and Kannada knowledge
* Ability to understand brand tone and communicate ideas clearly.
* Familiarity with social media trends and content creation tools is desirable.
* Willingness to learn, meet deadlines, and work collaboratively with the marketing team.

Eligibility

* Graduates or candidates with relevant qualifications in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Literature, Marketing, or related fields are preferred. **Graduation is not a mandatory requirement if with relevant industrial experience.**
* Candidates with a strong writing portfolio may also apply.
* Experience: 0–2 years; freshers are welcome.

What We Offer

* Salary package of ₹12,000–₹20,000 per month, based on skills and experience.
* Opportunity to develop professional writing and digital marketing skills.
* Exposure to healthcare education, institutional branding, and student recruitment campaigns.
* A collaborative work environment with opportunities to showcase creativity.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with an updated résumé and writing samples or portfolio, if available.

**Walk-in Interview:** Monday, 28th,29th October 2026  
**Venue:** Wellcaza School of Health Sciences, Edappally Raghavan Pillai Road, Elamakkara, Kochi, Ernakulam District, Kerala – 682026.  
**Contact for location assistance:** 80899 20900

**Bring:** Updated résumé and samples of your writing, social media content, blogs, or copywriting work.

*If you love words, understand audiences, and can turn ideas into engaging content, we would love to hear from you!*

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Technical content writer
description:
**Technical content writer**

Experience: **2-3 years**

**Required Skills**

* Impeccable written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Understand technology and turn complex technical concepts into high-quality & plagiarism-free content that is technically accurate by adhering to deadlines.
* Work closely with UI/UX developers and participate in design meetings.
* Ensure compliance with documentation styles and standards.
* Ability to capture information by performing web research.
* Understand technical writing principles like single sourcing, minimalism, and topic-based writing.

**Good to have**

* Experience with BA tools that include Balsamiq cloud, MS Visio.
* Knowledge of SDLC & DDLC
* Basic designing skills in Figma or XD
* Ability to develop wireframes/prototypes using wireframing tools.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kochi, Kerala
